title: What Restaurant Playbook Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of restaurant playbook: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Opening a restaurant: 60% fail in year one, mostly from undercapitalization. Success = great location math, tight food costs (28-35%), and 6+ months of operating cash.

Why it matters: Food cost target: 28-35% of menu price Labor: 25-35% of revenue

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Restaurant Playbook
summary: Start restaurant playbook this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Validate concept with pop-ups/catering
2. Write the business plan
3. Secure funding (6-12 mo runway)
4. Pick location on the math
5. Design a tight, profitable menu

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Restaurant Playbook Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with restaurant playbook — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Undercapitalization (the #1 killer) → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Too-big menu → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Bad location to save rent → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- No marketing budget → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.
